Q1.rationale: Segment 14 expressly bars reverse engineering, disassembling or recreating Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 8 deems the terms of the Agreement and the fact that the parties are holding feasibility discussions to be Confidential Information, so disclosure of that fact is restricted by segment 10.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: Segment 34 states that nothing in the Agreement grants any right, license or otherwise to Confidential Information.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Return or destruction under segments 25-28 is triggered by written demand of the Disclosing Party, not by termination of the Agreement, so the termination trigger is absent.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Segment 7 covers products, customer data, marketing plans and financial information, not only technical information, so the NDA is incompatible with a technical-only scope.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segment 7 covers information whether or not marked Confidential, so marking or identification by the Disclosing Party is not required.
Q6.label: Contradiction

Q7.rationale: Segment 39 sets a five-year term but the NDA has no express clause stating that any obligations survive termination.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: Segment 20 excludes independently developed information, and segment 42 preserves the right to develop competitive products, which permits independent development of similar information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: The NDA has no clause allowing retention of Confidential Information after return or destruction; segment 28 requires destruction with certification.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q10.rationale: Segment 7 expressly includes information in oral form within Confidential Information.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation covenant regarding Disclosing Party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 10 bars disclosure to any third party without prior written consent, which carves out sharing with third parties (consultants and advisors included) only with consent; no unconditional category is named.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 14 prohibits copying Confidential Information in whole or in part, a flat restriction with no carve-out for permitted copies.
Q13.label: Contradiction

Q14.rationale: Segment 21(v) permits disclosure under a court or government order only on prior written notice to the Disclosing Party under segment 22, and segment 23 gives an opportunity to oppose.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 19 excludes information that becomes available from a source other than Disclosing Party with the legal right to use and disclose it, which permits acquiring similar information from a third party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 10 permits restricted dissemination within the Receiving Party's organization to employees who need access.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 12 provides that any use of Confidential Information shall be solely for the purpose authorized in the Agreement.
Q17.label: Entailment
